correctness.rationale: PASS. Definition requires each 0-vertex to have exactly one adjacent 2 and no positive-support isolate. For G_{n,k}=K_{n,n} minus k matching edges (n>=3), weight 4 requires exactly adjacent 2s on unaffected vertices a_i,b_j with i,j>k, hence (n-k)^2 optima if k<n. For crown k=n, no weight <=5 is possible; weight-six configurations are precisely Type M (matched 2s plus one extra positive in each part) and Type X (unmatched 2s plus cross-part 1s) except n=3 admits all-ones and twelve one-2 patterns. Counts give n(n-1)^2+n(n-1)=n^2(n-1) plus 13 at n=3. Independently exhaustively enumerated every feasible labeling of weight <=6 for all n=3,4,5,6 and k=0..n: all minima and exact counts agreed; the proof treats arbitrarily large n by number of 2-labels.
residual_risks: The statement depends on TOTAL perfect Roman, not perfect Roman or ordinary total Roman; conflation would reverse the crown optimum.
